name: Vadilal Industries Limited
summary: Vadilal Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells ice-cream in India and internationally. The company offers flavored milk under the Power Sip brand; frozen desserts; processed food products, such as frozen fruits, vegetables, pulp, and ready-to-eat and ready-to-serve products, etc.; and other dairy products, as well as paneer and ghee products. It is also involved in the money changing and chemical businesses. Vadilal Industries Limited was founded in 1907 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
